class.name: DiskChunkWFCIO
class.brief_description: Implements a IO handler for [ChunkWFCEngine2D] that writes and reads from disk.
class.description: The implementation of this handler requires 2 files. An index which pairs the chunk coordinates with their file offset and a data file which constains a bit stream of every saved generated chunk so far.

method.name: flush_index
method.description: Saves the index and data state to disk, automatically triggered after every new chunk write.

method.name: open
method.description: Factory function, any instance created without this method is invalid.
